lines.text: Pitter, patter, pitter, patter. Here comes the rain!
Yay! It's puddle time!
Pip puts on his yellow raincoat, and his big red boots!
Let's count the puddles, and jump in every one!
Jump, jump! Splash, splash! Puddles are so much fun!
Puddle number one. Jump! Splash!
Puddle number two. Jump! Splash!
Puddle number three. Wheee! Splash!
Puddle number four. Big jump! Splash!
Puddle number five. Look, it's Bo the frog! Hop, hop, splash!
Ribbit! Can I jump too?
Puddle number six. Pip and Bo jump together! Splash!
Puddle number seven. Quack, quack! Here comes Dot the duck! Splash!
Quack! Wait for me!
Puddle number eight. Everybody spin! Splash!
Puddle number nine. Splash!
Puddle number ten. Uh oh! It's a really big one!
One, two, three, jump! Super splash!
We're soaking wet!
Shake, shake, shake! Drip, drip, drop!
Look! The rain stopped, and there's a rainbow!
Let's count them again! One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
Jump, jump! Splash, splash! Puddles are so much fun!
Bye bye! See you next rainy day!
